in_scope_clauses.summary:
8 risk management principles — integrated (part of all
activities), structured + comprehensive, customized (tailored
to org context), inclusive (stakeholder engagement), dynamic
(responsive to change), best available information, human +
cultural factors, continual improvement.

Risk management framework — leadership + commitment +
integration into governance + design + implementation +
evaluation + improvement of the framework itself. Distinct
from the risk management PROCESS (§6) which is the operational
execution.

Risk management process — communication + consultation; scope
+ context + criteria; risk assessment (identification +
analysis + evaluation); risk treatment; monitoring + review;
recording + reporting. Iterative across the lifecycle.

Integration — risk management is integrated into ALL
organizational activities + functions. Not a separate
function; embedded in strategy + governance + decision-
making + operations. ISO 31000 + ISO 31010 (risk assessment
techniques) together provide the meta-framework supporting
domain-specific risk standards (ICH Q9 / HARA / TARA /
HACCP / etc.).

Policies for information security — defined, approved by management,
published, communicated to and acknowledged by relevant personnel
and interested parties, and reviewed at planned intervals or when
significant changes occur.

Legal, statutory, regulatory, and contractual requirements relevant
to information security shall be identified, documented, and kept
up to date. The organization's approach to meeting each shall be
defined.

Separation of development, test, and production environments —
including separation of duties where appropriate — to reduce the
risk of unauthorized access or unauthorized changes to the
operational environment.

in_scope_clauses.section: Annex SL high-level structure (HLS) — common to all Annex SL standards
in_scope_clauses.summary:
Shared high-level structure — Annex SL HLS provides common
clause numbering across all ISO management-system standards:
§4 Context of organisation; §5 Leadership; §6 Planning;
§7 Support; §8 Operation; §9 Performance evaluation;
§10 Improvement. Common-clause identical text + discipline-
specific sub-clauses. IMS implementation leverages HLS for
single integrated documentation + single integrated
management review.

Shared policy + objectives — integrated quality + environment
+ OH&S + energy policy statement reflecting commitment to
all in-scope management systems. Per-MS objectives consolidated
into single objectives register; common cascade to operational
KPIs. Top management single signoff covering all included MSes.

Shared context + interested-party analysis — single context
analysis covering organisational external + internal issues
relevant to all included management systems; single
interested-parties register noting per-party expectations
across quality + environmental + OH&S + energy + IS scopes.

Integrated risk + opportunity register — single risk register
capturing quality risks (ISO 9001 §6.1) + environmental
aspects + impacts (ISO 14001 §6.1.2) + OH&S hazards + risks
(ISO 45001 §6.1.2) + IS risks (ISO 27001 §6.1.2) + energy
review-derived risks (ISO 50001 §6.3) + others. Common risk
assessment methodology (often ISO 31000-aligned). Composes
cleanly with iso-31000 meta-framework overlay.

Combined management review — single meeting + record covering
all in-scope MS-specific inputs per each standard's §9.3
(audit results, customer feedback, process performance,
nonconformities + corrective actions, monitoring + measurement
results, risk + opportunity status, supplier performance,
etc., plus MS-specific inputs like environmental performance,
OH&S performance, energy performance, IS performance). Outputs
consolidated into integrated improvement actions.

Combined audit programme — internal audits planned per ISO
19011:2018 covering multiple management systems in single
audit visits where practical. Auditor competency requirements
cover all in-scope MS standards. External certification body
may offer combined IMS certification audit (multi-MS audit
day-rate reduction; common observations resolution; single
integrated audit report).

Integrated documented-information control — single document-
control SOP covering all MS scopes; integrated document index
mapping documents to applicable MS clauses; common version
control + approval + distribution + retention rules. Single
records-retention SOP covering MS-specific retention
requirements (e.g., training records, calibration records,
incident records).

Annex SL HLS version tracking — ISO/IEC Directives Part 1
Annex SL revised periodically (Edition 2 in 2018; further
revisions ongoing); MS standards adopt revised HLS at next
standard revision. IMS implementation tracks per-MS standard
revision adoption + plans coordinated transitions
(e.g., ISO 9001 next revision; ISO 27001:2022 already
adopted Annex SL Edition 2 HLS).
